items.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
items.summary: Kaggle’s AI Agents Intensive with Google brought learners together in a no-cost course to build and deploy the next frontier of AI.

items.title: How we built a realtime system for responsive voice AI in six months
items.summary: GPT-Live enables continuous voice interaction with AI, using a turnless speech model and low-latency architecture for faster, more natural conversations.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI官方介绍了在六个月内研发的低延迟实时语音AI系统GPT-Live。该系统采用了全新的“无轮次”（turnless）语音模型和超低延迟架构，摆脱了传统对话中交替说话的限制，实现了更加自然、流畅的连续实时语音交互。文章展示了其在模型设计、通信工程与实时音频流处理方面的技术突破。
